name: Ottawa County, KS
findings: Ottawa County has 29 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (14%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: Ottawa County has 4 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Where do people here come together, and who brings them together? Which of those places would not show up in nonprofit records?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Ottawa County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
